faq.q: What is an AI fashion model generator?
faq.a: It shows your clothing or accessory worn by an AI-generated model. Start with one flat product photo and get a styled on-body image for your store.

faq.q: How does virtual model photography work?
faq.a: Upload a flat garment photo, choose a model and a scene, then generate. The item follows the color and cut in your reference photo.

faq.q: Which products work on a virtual model?
faq.a: Tops, dresses, outerwear and bags work well. A clear flat garment or accessory photo gives the model a better reference.

faq.q: Is it suitable for ecommerce stores?
faq.a: Yes. Use the worn view on a product page or social post, and keep a plain product photo for exact details and measurements.

faq.q: Can I choose the model and background?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a general adult look and a styled scene. Do not request a real celebrity, and expect small differences between results.

faq.q: Does the image prove how clothing fits?
faq.a: No. It shows a styled look, not a measured fitting. Keep verified measurements and a size chart in the listing.

faq.q: Can I run the photo in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add a price or offer in your ad editor after download.

faq.q: Do the garment details stay the same?
faq.a: Color and cut follow the flat photo, but small print or closure details can shift. Compare each result with the real item before publishing.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded flat heather-gray pullover hoodie as the exact garment reference. Preserve its gray color, hood, two drawstrings, kangaroo pocket, seams and relaxed cut. Show an adult man with short hair facing the camera in a tree-lined street, with his face and the entire hoodie visible. Change only the model and setting; keep the garment details consistent.
steps.sourceHint: Keep the complete hoodie, hood, drawstrings and pocket visible.
